hero.title: Define Your Minimum Viable Product.
hero.intro: Translate the Validate decision into bounded learning work, with conditions, exclusions and acceptance criteria.

questions.prompt: Does a working prototype prove demand?
options: No; functional checks and customer evidence are separate
questions.explanation: A prototype function is not demand proof.

questions.prompt: A Validate decision is pause with unresolved access. What is responsible?
questions.explanation: Lesson navigation does not override decision conditions.

questions.prompt: What belongs in the first build scope?
options: One learning outcome, minimum scope, exclusions, criteria and safeguards

sections.label: 01 / WATCH
sections.heading: What is the smallest build that helps you learn?

scenes.title: Bring the decision
scenes.narration: Build begins with the Validate decision record. Proceed permits only the defined bounded work; iterate or pause can mean further learning or resolving blockers first. Lesson access does not override those conditions.

scenes.title: Choose a learning outcome
scenes.narration: Choose one task and one assumption the next build should help check. A prototype can support learning without being a production service. Do not build a broad feature list before defining the question.

scenes.title: Bound the first build
scenes.narration: Choose the smallest prototype or transparent manual scope needed. State exclusions and missing capabilities. The prototype must not imply real payment, integrations or automation that do not exist.

scenes.title: Define acceptance
scenes.narration: Define what must work for the prototype and separately what customer evidence would address the assumption. Passing a functional check does not prove demand, adoption or production readiness.

scenes.title: Assign resources and safeguards
scenes.narration: Assign an owner, skill and dependency checks, time and resource boundaries. Keep estimates unknown if unsupported. Review access and data handling; stop dependent work when conditions are unresolved.

scenes.title: Write the brief
scenes.narration: Create a First Build Scope Brief with decision conditions, learning outcome, minimum scope, criteria, resources and safeguards. This lesson plans a build; it creates no product, deployment, customer evidence or launch approval.

sections.label: 02 / LEARN
sections.heading: Scope the work before adding features.

children: A
build scope
defines what you will create and exclude. A
learning outcome
explains why.
Acceptance criteria
define what must work; evidence criteria define what a later permitted test must reveal.
Manually review the Validate decision and unresolved conditions.
Choose one customer/task and learning assumption.
Specify the minimum prototype/manual workflow and exclusions.
Separate functional acceptance from customer evidence.
Assign owners, dependencies and resource boundaries.
Resolve safeguards before dependent execution.
Illustrative planned scope

Registration-entry concept: build two static screens to explore route understanding, excluding payments, accounts and live integrations. Functional check: route links reach the correct mock screen. Customer evidence: a later permitted uncoached task, with scope and source limits. Access pending; no actual test or product build exists.

Proceed means the bounded step recorded in Validate. Iterate or pause can require research/blocker resolution first; planning here is still useful but does not grant execution approval. Do not imply real automation or production readiness. No product is built by this worksheet.

options.feedback: Functional check passed; customer evidence and demand remain separate.

children: Local autosave only; plaintext browser storage. Use anonymous planning notes.
Fixed scripted demonstration; no AI/backend. Cannot verify feasibility, permissions, evidence or readiness.

modes.label: Teach Me
modes.response: Simulated teach: Priorities express scoped necessity, not popularity or proof of demand. No live AI answer or evidence verification.

modes.label: Guide Me
modes.response: Simulated guide: Start with one MVP task, list candidate features and explain each inclusion or deferral. No live AI answer or evidence verification.

modes.label: Review My Work
modes.response: Scripted field check: {missing} required fields empty. Counts only; no source or feasibility verification.

modes.label: Challenge My Idea
modes.response: Simulated challenge: Which dependency, essential safeguard or contradictory evidence would change the feature set? No live AI answer or evidence verification.

question.label: Your question
question.response: Scripted demonstration, not an AI answer to your question. Keep the scope bounded and honour Validate conditions.
